paragraphs: Streamline sells a website platform built for special districts. The platform covers compliant websites, marketing, intranet, and payment tools tailored for special districts. Websites are ADA compliant by default and include built-in accessibility assistants that resolve most issues.

A built-in regulatory compliance checklist presents state and federal legislation affecting a district in one dashboard. Payment collection is built into the websites and is backed by Stripe. Training and support are free and unlimited for all users.

Plans are sold as a monthly subscription with no long-term contracts or hidden fees. Streamline has been serving districts across America since 2015. DocAccess is a separate product for making public documents accessible.

quote.text: Streamline is the only platform dedicated exclusively to serving the unique needs of special districts
